description: Get a ticker's relative volume (RVOL) right now, EXACTLY as the Signal8 company page and Terminal show it (same data, same rule). Use this for "what is $X's RVOL today / right now"; get_rvol_history only covers completed sessions and never has today. "session" is pre-market, open, after-hours or closed. "shown" is the one VOL + RVOL on screen now: in pre-market the time-of-day RVOL ("RVOL·TOD") when measured, else the full-session one; from the open, today's volume / the 30-day average daily volume ("RVOL·D"). "displayed" lists the RVOL cells the Terminal draws, in order: pre-market RVOL·TOD then RVOL·D, from the open RVOL·D only. "premarket" (today's 04:00-09:30) has "rvolTimeOfDay" (vs the average traded by this time of morning, with its 15-minute "cutoff"), "rvolFullSession" (vs the average FULL pre-market), "avgVolumeByNow" and "avgFullSessionVolume". "day" has "volume", "rvol" (RVOL·D, null before the open) and "avgVolume30d". Every RVOL carries its "label" and a "note" naming its denominator; RVOL·TOD and RVOL·D differ by orders of magnitude early in the morning and are not interchangeable. "found": false means no live row for the ticker. Null means NOT MEASURED, never zero volume.

ticker.description: Company identifier: the current ticker (e.g. "AAPL"), a former ticker of a renamed or delisted company (e.g. "MIGI", now BGDE), or a numeric SEC CIK (e.g. "320193" or "0000320193"). A former ticker or a CIK is answered with a `resolvedFrom` block naming the current symbol.

name: get_live_rvol
title: Get Live RVOL
